SCRIPT: "In the 1920s our region on the Black Sea had no roads. Our founder solved this first with a raft, then with trade, and in 1937 with the first Ulusoy coach. He gave the business one principle: Everything on Time. In a factory project this means installation windows, commissioning dates and the customer's production ramp-up. A delay costs the customer production. That discipline is what we bring to project coordination in Türkiye."

TRANSITION: "Three generations then built on this principle."
